fit_reason: Whole boat with trailer listed by a private owner in boats by owner; a parts-or-restore project, but still a complete hull we can polish and clean.
findings: Red gelcoat on the deck and topsides looks somewhat dull and uneven in places rather than glossy
White lower hull sides show light staining and a flat, slightly chalky look along the port side
Deck surfaces in the bow area have scattered spots, specks and marks
Bow walkthrough floor is dirty with debris and loose, peeling material
Black rub rail looks faded and weathered along the sides
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1973 Switzer Craft. The red deck gelcoat and white hull sides look a little dull, and the bow walkthrough has some dirt and debris, which a cleanup and gelcoat polish could help with in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale details and gelcoat polishing that come to you. Would you like a quote?
